scenario.description: A festival partnerships director must approve the sponsor-integration plan for the opening-night livestream, including logo placement, commercial inventory, audience data collection, host language, and the production records needed before launch.

shared_context.S1: The festival's opening-night ceremony will be livestreamed from the Grand Hall on October 4.
shared_context.S2: Brightline Mobile is the presenting sponsor for the livestream.
shared_context.S3: The draft activation plan places a Brightline logo on the stage backdrop, reserves a ten-minute commercial break, collects audience email addresses for sponsor follow-up, and gives the host a sponsor thank-you during the award presentation.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the binding approval for the activation plan.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal pre-launch sign-off, Maya reviews the plan with sponsorship contracts, broadcast traffic, and audience-data compliance before the rundown and public-facing materials are locked.
shared_context.S6: The sign-off checklist requires the contract manager, traffic manager, and data compliance coordinator to give their area-by-area clearance or required correction in the meeting, and requires Maya to record each required correction as a named action before approving the plan.
shared_context.S7: Before approval, Maya reads back the exact final value for each activation-plan field and the exact name of each required action; the responsible area owner confirms each readback against their records, and Maya approves only after all three owners have confirmed.

PF1.text: Jonah reviewed the executed Brightline amendment yesterday and confirmed that its logo may appear only as a lower-third graphic during the livestream, not on the stage backdrop; he has not entered the amendment into the sponsorship deal memo yet.

PF2.text: Rina confirmed with the streaming distributor this morning that the available commercial inventory is exactly one six-minute break, not ten minutes; she has not updated the broadcast traffic sheet yet.

PF3.text: Luis completed the festival privacy assessment this week and found that sponsor follow-up email collection is prohibited for this event, including through the current registration form; he has not revised the audience-data workflow yet.

decisions.logo_placement: string; use the exact approved value 'lower-third graphic only'
decisions.commercial_break_minutes: integer; use the exact distributor-confirmed number
decisions.sponsor_email_collection: boolean; use false if collection is prohibited
decisions.host_thank_you_timing: string; preserve the drafted timing unless an area owner requires a correction

acceptance_conditions: The Brightline logo must appear only as a lower-third graphic.
The commercial break must be exactly six minutes.
Sponsor follow-up email collection must be disabled.
The host thank-you must occur during the award presentation.
The sponsorship deal memo must be updated to record the logo restriction.
The broadcast traffic sheet must be updated to record the six-minute inventory.
The audience-data workflow must be revised to remove sponsor follow-up email collection.

decisive_facts.why: The executed amendment changes the logo placement from the stage backdrop to the exact value 'lower-third graphic only' and requires the sponsorship deal memo to record that restriction.
The distributor confirmation changes the commercial break from ten minutes to exactly six minutes and requires the broadcast traffic sheet to record the available inventory.
The privacy assessment changes sponsor follow-up email collection from enabled to disabled and requires the audience-data workflow to remove that collection.
